name: Late Night Delivery
source:
Life couldn't get any worse for you. A dead-end job delivering pizzas, a beat up rustbucket of a car, and no prospects for the future. 

Then your car breaks down in the middle of nowhere, and you catch the scent of pumpkin pie wafting from one warm-looking house. 

That's right, wasn't tonight Halloween…?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230129192242/https://monsterboxgames.itch.io/latenightdelivery]Itch.io[/url]]
